response: Yes, cup-cage reconstruction with oversized cups can provide initial stability in total hip arthroplasty (THA) for osteoporotic acetabular fractures. Although the contact surface between the component and pelvic bone may be small, the majority of acetabular components in this type of reconstruction have been found to be stable. However, it's worth noting that some components may migrate over time, and additional screw fixation to the ischial tuberosity and superior pubic ramus may be necessary to enhance stability.
